dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge with a hyperbolic curvature transitioning from a steep descent near the apex to a broad horizontal flare at the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded-obtuse profile with a localized terminal notch at the highest vertical pixel coordinate.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear anterior margin inclined at approximately 45 degrees relative to the visible horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 2.5:1 ratio of maximum horizontal base width to maximum vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Three distinct irregular notches on the trailing edge; small terminal excision at the apex; dense cluster of white depigmented pitting and linear scarring at the lower anterior base.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white speckled pigmentation pattern localized to the ventral-anterior transition of the fin base.
